meta.name: FIFA+
meta.description:
Bringing fans into the heart of football with the iconic World Cup Archive, Live football from around the globe and documentaries bring the stories behind the beautiful game.

Shows: The Best of FIFA World Cup Korea & Japan 2002™, FACTS: Brazil v France | France 98, USA v Thailand | Group F | FIFA Women's World Cup France 2019™ | Full Match Replay, FACTS: Spain v England | Australia/New Zealand 2023, FACTS: USA v China PR | USA 1999
Available on: Samsung TV Plus, Plex
